...

This includes his infant son, Romulus, who Elon didn’t publicly confirm until months after a paternity test revealed he is the boy’s father.

Before Musk became the world's richest man and a pop culture figure, he was married to Canadian author Justine Wilson. The two met while studying at Queen’s University in Ontario, Canada, and eventually tied the knot in 2000. Their marriage lasted eight years, but it was filled with challenges, including a devastating personal loss.In 2002, Justine gave birth to Nevada Alexander Musk, the couple’s first child. However, tragedy struck when Nevada passed away at just 10 weeks old due to Sudden Infant Death Syndrome (SIDS). The loss was heartbreaking, but Justine and Elon continued trying for more children through IVF treatments.Between 2004 and 2006, the couple welcomed five more children:Twins (Griffin Musk and Vivian Jenna Wilson) – born in 2004Triplets (Kai Musk, Saxon Musk, and Damian Musk) – born in 2006Despite their large family, Musk and Wilson's marriage fell apart by 2008. A former Yale University graduate and an executive at Neuralink, Shivon shares Musk’s passion for artificial intelligence and brain-computer interfaces.In November 2021, it was revealed that she and Musk secretly welcomed twins through IVF, just weeks before Musk had his second child with Grimes. The twins were named:Strider MuskAzure MuskTheir existence was only discovered through court documents, in which Musk and Zilis filed a petition to give the children his last name.Less than three years later, in February 2024, Shivon gave birth to their third child, Arcadia Musk.
